articles.title: Morpho poised to scale as DeFi infrastructure play, Standard Chartered says
articles.snippet: The bank initiated coverage of Morpho with a $60 end-2030 price target, saying its DeFi lending and onchain infrastructure businesses are positioned to benefit from tokenization growth.

articles.title: Has Strategy’s capital overhaul put an end to ‘death spiral’ fears?
articles.snippet: Strategy's latest plan includes MSTR and STRC buybacks, expanded cash reserves and even potential Bitcoin sales. Will it be enough to defuse the overheated “death spiral” fears?
